items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: We played together all the time. He played first and I played second.

ctx.x: You were talking about Zoo Robertson? Zoo Robertson, yeah.

He was the only man, he was one of the best fellas that would go with me in bands, playing those brass band jobs, you know, like that. We played together all the time. He played first and I played second. He played on one side and I played on the other. You know, in fumes and like that. He was very good. Nice trombone player. Sweet, you know. Not a lot of harshness. He just played nice and sweet. When he had to play loud, well, he could play loud. But he always played. We'd practice that together. I used to go to…
Was he about the same age or a little older?
